program.title: Section 232 — passenger vehicles and light trucks
program.detail: Proclamation 10908 passenger vehicles (sedans, SUVs, CUVs, minivans, cargo vans) and light trucks. Distinct from the auto-parts annex (9903.94.05). USMCA non-U.S. content path 9903.94.03 requires Commerce approval — not auto-assessed.

source: CSMS #64624801 — GUIDANCE: Import Duties on Certain Automobiles (U.S. note 33 subdiv. (a)–(e))

9903.94.03.note: Commerce approval required — do not auto-report

notes: 8704.60.00 also appears on the MHDV vehicle list (Proclamation 10984). Default is passenger 9903.94.01 unless flags.s232_mhdv is set.
